oracle.body:
Thranduil has all activated abilities of all Elf cards in your graveyard.
Whenever another legendary Elf you control enters, draw two cards, then discard a card.

rules_authority.notes: Full source, official text and rulings: all activated abilities, self-name substitution, linked ability pair acquired only for same continuous instance. CR113.6/201.5,602.5b/702.177,607.5,400.7 and611.3 support source zones, separate acquisition limits and exact incarnations.

full_read: Complete pinned Thranduil class, Ooze analogue, entry trigger, DrawDiscardControllerEffect, FilterControlledPermanent, AnotherPredicate, SimpleStaticAbility, StaticAbility and ActivatedAbilityImpl bodies. Complete Oracle and official full Thranduil release-note section read.

shared_contract.typed_provider: BorrowGraveyardActivations("Elf") static fragment, explicit source registration and shared layer-six availability; no English interpreter or new IDs.
shared_contract.inventory: All actual card donors in current controller-owned GY, current exact generation and subtype over supplied CharacteristicWorld; noncreature Kindred cards and changeling included, tokens excluded. No GY owner/controller conflation. Only real activated tables and intrinsic mana; hidden acquired templates excluded.
shared_contract.continuity: Private optional copy-on-write acquisition rows keyed source/provider/copy-origin/controller/donor/definition, active flag, source-local monotonic slot ranges. Inactive ranges retained until source leaves, preventing rebind and use-history collision; share namespace with existing linked-exile borrowing. Actual instruction-boundary and copy-availability refresh; unchanged rows preserve COW storage.
shared_contract.funding: Owned borrowing projection plus acquisition rows in memo key; virtual departures/entries/control changes feed same-world inventory including provisional new donors. Opt-in worlds avoid nonconservative current-inventory optimistic bound because sacrifice may introduce new abilities; actual exact reachability still decides legal payment. Ordinary worlds allocate no acquisition registry and scan no graveyard for this rule.
shared_contract.source_and_costs: Existing captured activation item keeps donor program with actual permanent source/object/controller/P-T/counters/copiable recipe. Source-zone/timing/tap/sacrifice/discard/targets/once/exhaust/quality/rollback paths reused; new public mana tags integrated into owned replay/accounting and policy.
shared_contract.wire: Requires central schema164 or later: AnnounceGraveyardBorrowedAbility, AnnounceGraveyardBorrowedMana, ActivateGraveyardBorrowedMana with graveyard:ObjectRef; optional omitted-empty Observation.graveyard_borrowed_abilities rows{source,graveyard,definition,ability,slot,used}. Existing exile actions/views retain fields and first-link source ordering. Leaf central version remains inherited162; parent adopted163 during authoring and owns integration bump.
shared_contract.owned_bytes: Acquisition State initialized rows/Vec header counted; pending actions counter payload accounted in mana allocation and zone replacement owners; funding memo includes exact acquisition records. Whole-state snapshots/rollback retain COW records.
shared_contract.review_boundaries: Dawnhand Dissident is the only Elf in frozen pool with an exile/play linked pair and remains gated; no fixture, unrelated admission or new linked-exile card machinery was invented. Fresh acquired-instance identities are established and proved by real exhaust/once/copy/suppression cases. A future Dawnhand admission must separately prove its linked pair using that acquisition identity; this leaf does not claim its gated behavior works.

obligations.rule: 2BGU legendary5/6 Elf Noble; own entry excluded
obligations.outcome: Both seats pay UBG+2 exactly; current5/6 and legendary/Elf/Noble. No self ETB draw.

obligations.rule: All activated abilities from own graveyard Elf CARDS
obligations.outcome: Morcant Eyes is noncreature Kindred Elf; acquired4GG sacrifice ability sacrifices Thranduil, leaves donor, produces3 real2/2Elf tokens including just-sacrificed source in count. Three Tree Mascot changeling also qualifies.

Own Elf donor mana and Harper nonmana, reject opponent GY/hand/library donor. Mana blocked by recipient summoning sickness, then actual G mana and5-mana unblockable effect. Actual payment-window ActivateGraveyardBorrowedMana pays a separate1G creature cast.
Guardian5GG puts3 counters on Thranduil (8/9), none on donor; Topiary mana produces8 green from actual current recipient power, not donor1.

obligations.rule: Self discard costs and granted keywords
obligations.outcome: No hand rejects activation; actual additional discard, source tapped and indestructible after resolution. GY donor stays put and receives no keyword.
Graveyard-only Stoic ability exists but cannot activate from BF. Harper target blink and donor exile preserve stale-target failure, do not rebound new incarnation.

obligations.rule: Once-per-turn, exhaust, donor/source incarnations and suppression
obligations.outcome: Three Tree once limit enforced; donor depart/reentry creates fresh slot and old-ref action rejects. Greenbelt exhaust consumed; Witness Protection removes borrowing; source restoration gets fresh acquisition and real second activation counters.

obligations.rule: Current controller graveyard rather than source owner; independent stack ability
obligations.outcome: Control record switches donor pool; already-paid old-controller counter ability resolves onto same source. Source Hand/BF reentry has exact new generation, original-owner GY pool, no rebound old-source acquisition.
Actual shared in-place copy to Bear removes borrowed inventory; expiry restores5/6 Thranduil and fresh acquisition slot without moving source/donor.

obligations.rule: Another legendary Elf ETB draw2, then mandatory private discard1
obligations.outcome: Actual paid Elrond entry draws2, hand2/library6 before mandatory discard. Opponent sees no drawn identities, wrong actor rejected, no decline. Source leaves before chosen discard and captured trigger still completes1-card discard.
Nonlegendary Elf, opposing legendary Elf, own legendary Human do not draw. Bard doubles actual two draws to4 then precisely one mandatory discard ->hand3.

obligations.rule: Inherited triggered abilities are excluded; actual borrowed creature activations observed
obligations.outcome: GY Elrond observer is not acquired. Live Elrond sees actual Thranduil borrowed mana activation and draws once; second same-turn activation draws no extra.

obligations.rule: Owned public action, targets, payment and private pending state
obligations.outcome: Public graveyard names verified; old exile names absent in new donor view/action. Existing wrong-actor/index/restore contract plus actual independent raw/index/drop-parent target branches and identical final unblockable outcomes.

Valid one-slot range ends at u64MAX. Actual mandatory Elf discard requires another slot and fails capacity; entire action state/revision/hand restore. Restored capacity allows actual discard and acquired ability.

obligations.rule: Same-world mana planning after virtual sacrifice
obligations.outcome: Lotus Ring sacrifices Elf virtually; Thranduil gains new virtual donor mana while live Game Elf remains BF. Reachable4green is then produced by actual sacrifice and actual borrowed mana. Both seats, snapshot unchanged during projection.
